notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed bug with Larry being an unskippable cutscene. HUGE SHOUTOUT TO REMIX for finding this bug.

notes.title: Finished updating refactor work
notes.content:
Fixed bug with Larry and being able to jump across the pit. 
Fixed other bugs with scripts not playing/exiting animations properly.
Fixed bug with being able to double jump to cannon without Lonk.
Fixed bug with floor levels not appearing with different types of resolutions.

notes.title: Bug fixes and Resolution improvement.
notes.content:
Fixed issue with wide screen monitors. Started refactoring different scripts to improve performance and fix bugs.
Huge shoutout to ReMiX for bringing this to my attention.

More bug fixes to come with this new update.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
There was a bug reported on the double jump power up dialog confirmation. This bug has been addressed along with another bug with the first boss animation. 

Bug Fixes:
 - Powerup dialog for double jump only appears after collecting double jump
 - Powerup dialog goes away after collecting double jump
 - Rat boss animation stops playing and state has been fixed if user tries to skip cutscene.

notes.title: Fixed cutscene not playing in the future
notes.content:
Changes:

 - Future cutscene 'did he like it' now plays when you either use the pods or the time machine. After giving the ship repair guy the burrito.

 - Future Medic first meet cutscene now has subtitles.

notes.title: Latest Change for major bug fixes!
notes.content:
This patch includes the latest for all major bug fixes.

 - Powerup Dialog now displays text when you can close the menu.
 - Powerup Dialog now turns off after acquiring powerups and characters.
 - Rocket Launcher no longer makes destructible objects float away.
 - Doors in present time line now play audio.
 - Player no longer gets stuck in arch ways in the Past time line.
 - Audio Plays in Main Menu.
 - Changed how particle effects look on keys.
 - Made the weapon icons more visible at the top of the screen.
 - Fixed the issue with locked doors always making a sound when not in front of them.
      Now locked doors only make the sound when interacting with them, directly.
 - Fixed issue with Rocket Launcher powerup pushing you back.
 
These patches have been made possible thanks to a friend of mine bug testing this game.

notes.title: More Improvements!!!
notes.content:
Fixed player getting stuck on the arch ways in the past timeline.
Fixed some breakables from randomly floating (still WIP)
Brought back the videos section in the main menu.

notes.title: More Bug Fixes and improvements!!!
notes.content:
Fixed the player going into the walls of the first dungeon.
Fixed the bug with no audio playing in the main menu.

Added in a new option to skip cutscenes by button press.
Added in new feature that displays what the powerups/weapons/characters do.

Unfortunately, the videos in the main menu had to be removed, temporarily but they will be back in a later update.

notes.title: More bugfixes!
notes.content:
A very good friend of mine informed me of these bugs. These bugs have been addressed and more changes to come!

Fixed wall disappearing in the first dungeon when meeting the rat boss.

Fixed the text and crosshairs, no longer appears at the start of the game.

Fixed the first pistol in the game. It now reloads and fires instantly.

More changes to come soon! Thank you very much to those who support this project and to my friends who find these bugs for me.

notes.title: Optimization Patch
notes.content: Blue Slayer has found an issue running on devices with integrated graphics and low end of ram specs. A fix for that has been push. As more bugs are found those will be fixed as well.

notes.title: Interact hotfix
notes.content:
During testing and adding new features. Blue Slayer Gaming realized the keyboard key "E" for interacting with objects and opening doors was broken. 
This has now been fixed.

notes.title: Finished Controller Support
notes.content:
We have fully implemented X-Box controller support into the game.

Fixed bug when using 3rd person camera and not seeing crosshairs or doors.
Got 3rd person cam working on the X-Box controller.
Got the aim feature working while using the X-Box controller.
Cleaned up the controller image that is displayed.

notes.title: Update Round 2 for Full Controller Support
notes.content: fixed small bug in the options menu after getting controller support to work.

notes.title: Update Notes for 02/08/2024
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
1: trigger posts and targets now perform additional checks when loading into a dungeon.

Improvements:
1: Improved bread crumbs.
2: Improved reload speed of the past pistol.
3: Changed layout of the 2nd dungeon.
4: Added lights to targets to indicate if they've been activated or not.
